Theorem 3 combines Lemma 1, the first part of Lemma 4, Lemma 6, and (3) with beta=1/3. The corollary had already been established for t<=5100; the conclusion applies Theorem 2 for 5100<=t<=4 times 10^14 and Theorem 3 for t>=4 times 10^14.
